name: LD2 (Labour) Visa with Work Permit

requirements.blocker_text: Either a university degree or higher plus at least 3 years' relevant working experience, or at least 5 years' experience plus a relevant practising certificate (Decree 152/2020, Article 3.3).

requirement_groups.name: Technical worker (lao động kỹ thuật) qualification

requirements.blocker_text: Either at least 1 year of technical/vocational training plus 3 years' relevant experience, or at least 5 years' relevant working experience (Decree 152/2020, Article 3.6).

evidence_required.document: Employment verification letters covering the required experience period
Employer's registered business license and labour-demand approval
Health check certificate; criminal record certificate

outcome.duration_length: visa up to 2 years; temporary residence card up to 2 years, renewable while employed

sources.title: LuatVietnam (private legal database) -- LD1 (work-permit-exempt) and LD2 (work-permit-required) labour visa categories, up to 2 years, Article 9

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Vietnam). STATUS: DRAFT, TIER-3 ONLY -- Decree 152/2020/ND-CP is a genuine Vietnamese government decree, but no .gov.vn-hosted copy was independently fetched in this pass; the text here comes from a private legal-database translation. work_rights is 'restricted' since the permit ties employment to the specific approved employer/role, not an open work authorization. LD1 (work-permit-exempt, e.g. intra-corporate transferees, treaty cases, or capital contributors with VND 3bn+ per Decree 152 Article 7.1) exists as a parallel route but is not modeled as a separate file here since it is fundamentally an EXEMPTION from this route's requirements rather than a distinct qualifying pathway -- disclosed rather than duplicated. No distinct self-employed/freelance ('work_independent') visa category was found in Vietnamese law: the system is built around either sponsored employment (LD) or capital investment in a registered entity (DT/DN), not general independent contracting for an individual -- this is a genuine structural absence, disclosed here rather than a route being force-fit into the work_independent category.
